queries: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(t.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(t.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(t.total_cost - a.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS a WHERE t.total_cost > a.average_spend;

WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(t.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(t.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(t.total_cost - a.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS a WHERE t.total_cost > a.average_spend;
